result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but several visual issues were found: content cut off on the right edge in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, a truncated restaurant name, and a red badge clipping over the notification bell icon.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only a partial card ('Trattoria Piccolo'), which may look like broken rendering rather than an intentional carousel.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle peek/edge-fade indicator or slight horizontal padding so partial cards are clearly recognizable as a scrollable carousel.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated with no ellipsis, and its price row is only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with ellipsis or allow the name to wrap so it remains readable even when partially scrolled.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red badge dot that slightly overlaps/clips outside the circular button boundary.
issues.suggestion: Adjust badge positioning so the red dot sits cleanly on the icon's corner without clipping outside the button shape.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi'...) appears to have another chip partially cut off at the right edge with no visual cue of scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade-out gradient or partial chip visibility cue to indicate horizontal scrolling.
